newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin's Indian casinos rake in $7 billion.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin's Indian casinos rake in $7 billion.

text.p: Wisconsin's Indian gambling casinos grossed more than $7 billion over a 12-month period, according to a state report.
Tribal and state officials said the figure was the total bet on games such as blackjack and in slot machines before prizes and operating costs were subtracted.
The report, released Wednesday, covered a 12-month period ending in June, 1996, and was the first such accounting the state has made.
The gross figure caused some amazement.
"That's a lot of disposable income kicking around," said state Senate President Fred Risser, a Democrat from Madison who opposes gambling.
